title: Perfect Rectangles
goal: Solve Perfect Rectangles: Verify whether a set of axis-aligned rectangles cover the entire grid perfectly with no overlap or gaps.
strategy: Verify whether a set of axis-aligned rectangles cover the entire grid perfectly with no overlap or gaps.
inputRules: Input must be an array of rectangles
Each rectangle must have 4 values: [x1, y1, x2, y2]
